p: Judah went down from his brethren: Moses describes the genealogy of Judah, because the Messiah should come from him.
and he took her: A relationship which nonetheless was condemned by God.

up seed to thy brother: This order was for the preservation of the stock, since the child begotten by the second brother would have the name and inheritance of the first: a practice which is abolished in the New Testament.
Remain a widow at thy father's: For she could not marry in any other family so long as Judah would retain her in his.
knew not that she was his: God miraculously blinded him so that he could not know her by her voice.
friend the Adullamite: That his wickedness might not be known to others.
shamed: He fears man more than God.
burnt: We see that the Law, which was written in man's heart, taught them that adultery should be punished with death, even though no law had been given yet.
more righteous than I: That is, she ought rather to accuse me than I her.
no more: for the horror of the sin condemned him.
drew back his hand: Their heinous sin was signified by this monstrous birth.
hast thou broken forth: Or the separation between you and your brother.
